import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot showing the average transaction amount by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=data, ci=None, estimator='mean', palette='pastel')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Average Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Fraud Status (0: No Fraud, 1: Fraud)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Average Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
